package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for prepare_on_every_request_same_sql: The same literal SQL is prepared multiple times on one request path.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
var sharedDB *sql.DB

func HandleUserQuery(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := r.URL.Query().Get("id")

	stmt, err := sharedDB.Prepare("SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE id = $1")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "prepare failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer stmt.Close()

	var name, email string
	err = stmt.QueryRow(userID).Scan(&name, &email)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	orderStmt, err := sharedDB.Prepare("SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "prepare failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer orderStmt.Close()

	var orderID int
	var total float64
	_ = orderStmt.QueryRow(userID).Scan(&orderID, &total)
	w.Write([]byte(name))
}
